sections.title: Expected goals pipeline
paragraphs: The engine splits attack into finishing and chance-creation channels (xA / xG-buildup / xG-chain credit all outfield positions), then applies opponent suppression (back line 54%, mid shield 32%, GK 14%) and midfield battle modifiers.
Team A raw attack xG: 2.24 finishing + 0.18 creation = 2.42 before suppression. When Team B defends, suppression factor is 0.834 (DEF 0.52, mid-def 0.38, GK 0.67, transition risk 0.38).
Team B raw attack xG: 2.17 + 0.17 = 2.34. Team A suppression when defending: 0.818 (transition risk 0.25).
Midfield battle multipliers: Team A ×1.002, Team B ×0.998. Net xG edge: Team B by 0.14.
